info.title: Furnace Client API
info.description:
Account-scoped REST API for campaigns, leads, people, saved lists, inbox, mailboxes, mailbox tags, stats, and block list.

Human-readable guides and API reference: **https://api.getfurnace.io/docs**

tags.name: Campaigns
tags.description: Read and mutate campaigns that belong to the authenticated account.

tags.name: Flow
tags.description: Read, validate, and update campaign flow graphs.

tags.name: Leads
tags.description: Manage campaign leads, including single-row upserts and bulk imports.

tags.name: Lead fields
tags.description: Inspect and extend required lead-field mappings derived from the campaign flow.

tags.name: Jobs
tags.description: Create and poll asynchronous bulk jobs (import, add/remove, pause/resume).

tags.name: People
tags.description: Account-scoped people explorer and profile updates.

tags.name: Lead lists
tags.description: Saved lead lists and list membership.

tags.name: Mailboxes
tags.description: Read account mailboxes, manage mailbox tags, and keep secret password fields out of responses.

tags.name: Inbox
tags.description: List and triage inbox threads, read messages, send replies and forwards, manage message jobs, out-of-office state, lead replacement, and thread tags.

tags.name: Block list
tags.description: List, add, and remove blocked email or domain values.

tags.name: Stats
tags.description: Read daily and aggregate campaign performance statistics.

CampaignFlow.description:
Directed acyclic graph (DAG) defining the campaign sequence. Consumed by flow save, validate, and optional `flow` on campaign create.

**Structure:**

- [FlowNode](/docs/reference/schemas/FlowNode/) — one step per node; `data` shape depends on `type`
- [FlowEdge](/docs/reference/schemas/FlowEdge/) — directed connections between nodes

**Node types:**

- `leadSource` — [LeadSourceNodeData](/docs/reference/schemas/LeadSourceNodeData/) (exactly one per flow)
- `email` — [EmailNodeData](/docs/reference/schemas/EmailNodeData/) with [EmailVariant](/docs/reference/schemas/EmailVariant/) variants
- `waitTime` — [WaitTimeNodeData](/docs/reference/schemas/WaitTimeNodeData/)
- `aiCategorizer` — [AICategorizerNodeData](/docs/reference/schemas/AICategorizerNodeData/) (at most one per flow)
- `dataSender` — [DataSenderNodeData](/docs/reference/schemas/DataSenderNodeData/)

**Validation rules:** exactly one `leadSource`; at most one `aiCategorizer`; max 100 nodes / 200 edges; no cycles; every node reachable from `leadSource`; unique node and edge ids.

Full normalization, merge-variable rules, and error codes: [Flow schemas guide](/docs/guides/flow-schemas/).

FlowPosition.description: Builder canvas coordinates. Cosmetic; safe to change on live campaigns.

x.description: Horizontal position in the flow editor.

y.description: Vertical position in the flow editor.

EmailVariant.description:
One A/B variant of an email node. Variant ids must be stable UUIDs. Supports merge variables in `subject`, `template`, and `body_html`.

See [Flow schemas](/docs/guides/flow-schemas/).

id.description: Stable variant UUID. Generate once before first save.

label.description: Display label (A, B, …). Re-derived on save.

subject.description: Email subject. Supports merge variables like {{first_name}}.

template.description: Primary email body (plain or rich text). Supports merge variables.

body_html.description: HTML body when editor_mode is html.

isActive.description: When false, variant is skipped in round-robin. At least one variant per email node must be active.

order.description: Round-robin sort order. Re-derived on save.

FlowNode.description: One node in the campaign flow graph. The data shape depends on type — see [LeadSourceNodeData](/docs/reference/schemas/LeadSourceNodeData/), [EmailNodeData](/docs/reference/schemas/EmailNodeData/), [WaitTimeNodeData](/docs/reference/schemas/WaitTimeNodeData/), [AICategorizerNodeData](/docs/reference/schemas/AICategorizerNodeData/), and [DataSenderNodeData](/docs/reference/schemas/DataSenderNodeData/).

id.description: Stable flow node id referenced by edges and runtime node sync. Keep stable across edits.

type.description: Node kind. Exactly one leadSource per flow; at most one aiCategorizer.

deletable.description: When false, node cannot be deleted in the builder. Lead source is always non-deletable.

FlowEdge.description: Directed connection between two nodes. Categorizer outgoing edges must set sourceHandle to interested, neutral, or not-interested.

sourceHandle.description: Required on aiCategorizer branch edges: interested, neutral, or not-interested.

type.description: Builder edge type. Stripped on save when set to deletable.

LeadSourceNodeData.description:
Configuration for the single required `leadSource` node. Declares merge variables and custom lead fields.

Allowed standard keys for mappedStandardFieldKeys: `email`, `name`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `company_name`, `website`, `linkedin_url`, `company_linkedin_url`, `source`.

Details: [Flow schemas](/docs/guides/flow-schemas/).

customFieldKeys.description: Custom personalization keys. Enables {{custom.<key>}} merge tokens and requires matching keys in lead custom_lead_data on import.

mappedStandardFieldKeys.description: Standard lead fields available as merge variables. When omitted, all standard fields are allowed.

isRequired.description: When true, leads missing required custom fields count as incomplete on import.

EmailNodeData.description:
Outbound email node with one or more A/B variants.

`send_mode`: `new` for sequence emails; `reply` for in-thread follow-ups after categorizer. See [EmailVariant](/docs/reference/schemas/EmailVariant/).

mailboxId.description: Sending mailbox. Falls back to campaign mailbox rotation when unset.

send_mode.description: new for sequence emails; reply for in-thread follow-ups after categorizer.

variants.description: 1–20 variants. At least one must be active.

WaitTimeNodeData.description: Delay node. `wait_duration_seconds` is the runtime source of truth; `duration` and `unit` are display fields derived on save.

duration.description: Display duration value. Furnace derives this from wait_duration_seconds on save.

unit.description: Display unit. Furnace derives this from wait_duration_seconds on save.

wait_duration_seconds.description: Positive delay in seconds. Required for runtime scheduling.

AICategorizerNodeData.description: Reply classifier node. At most one per flow. Outgoing edges must use sourceHandle interested, neutral, or not-interested.

use_ai.description: When true, uses AI to classify replies.

DataSenderNodeData.description: Webhook node that POSTs lead data to an external URL when a lead reaches this step. Supports merge variables in `payload`. See [CampaignFlow](/docs/reference/schemas/CampaignFlow/) examples for a full dataSender flow.

payload.description: JSON string body. Supports merge variables.

payload_template.description: Object form of payload. Serialized to payload on save when payload string is empty.

on_failure.description: Whether enrollment continues after a failed POST.

FlowUpdate.description:
Canonical campaign flow payload for `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/flow`, `PUT .../flow` (deprecated), and `POST .../flow:validate`.

Same shape as [CampaignFlow](/docs/reference/schemas/CampaignFlow/). See [Campaign flow](/docs/guides/campaign-flow/) and [Flow schemas](/docs/guides/flow-schemas/).

FlowValidationIssue.description:
One validation problem in `issues[]` from flow validate/save, or in `details[]` on `400 invalid_flow` errors.

See [Flow schemas](/docs/guides/flow-schemas/) for the full error-code catalog.

FlowValidateResult.description:
Dry-run result from `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/flow:validate`. Shows normalized flow, validation issues, change classification, and lifecycle gate outcome.

See [FlowValidationIssue](/docs/reference/schemas/FlowValidationIssue/) and [Flow schemas](/docs/guides/flow-schemas/).

allowed.description: Whether the campaign status permits this change (false when structural edit on live campaign).

change_kind.description: Classification of the diff against the stored flow.

change_reasons.description: Machine-readable change reasons: node_added, node_removed, node_type_changed, edge_added_or_rewired, edge_removed_or_rewired, variant_removed_or_replaced, content_changed.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle gate result. When blocked, code is flow_locked.

issues.description: Validation problems. Empty when the flow is valid.

enrolled.description: Number of leads enrolled at launch.

reactivated_count.description: Completed enrollments reactivated at former leaf nodes after an append save.

CampaignUpdate.description: Mutable campaign fields. Mailbox ids can replace the full set or be incrementally added and removed.

tag_ids.description: Replace all tag assignments on the campaign.

Lead.description: Lead row scoped to a campaign.

global_lead_id.description: Stable account-scoped person id (SHA-256 of normalized email). Used for enrollment pause/resume and bulk membership APIs.

LeadCreate.description: Create or upsert a lead. `email` is required. When the campaign defines custom lead fields, every key must be present in `custom_lead_data`.

incomplete.description: Leads imported but missing one or more required custom (personalization) fields.

input.description: Includes required `operation` and scope fields (`global_lead_ids`, `list_id`, or `leads`).

ImportJobCreate.description: Create an async bulk job. Poll `GET /v1/jobs/{id}` for completion.

Mailbox.description: Mailbox row with sensitive IMAP/SMTP passwords removed from the response.

tags.description: Mailbox tags assigned to this mailbox.

MailboxUpdate.description: Mutable mailbox fields currently support tag assignment only.

tag_ids.description: Replace all tag assignments on the mailbox.

ReplyRequest.description: Create a reply job for a thread message. When omitted, subject and recipient fields fall back to the target message.

in_reply_to_message_id.description: Message to reply to. Defaults to the latest message in the thread.

ForwardRequest.description: Create a forward job for a specific message in the thread.

ThreadUpdate.description: Partial thread update. All fields are optional.

read.description: When true, marks all received messages in the thread as read.

BulkMembershipActionResult.description: RPC result counts from sync membership operations.

Person.description: Account-scoped person rollup row from the people explorer.

BatchCompletionWebhookPayload.description: Standard payload for async or sync bulk completion webhooks.

OpenApiDocument.description: The live OpenAPI document returned by `/openapi.json`.

get.description: Checks that the API runtime is alive and can reach the backing database.

503.description: API is reachable but the database health check failed.

get.description: Returns the live OpenAPI contract served by Furnace.
Lists campaigns in the authenticated account. Results are paginated and can optionally include soft-deleted campaigns.

post.description: Creates a draft native campaign. Optional `flow` is normalized and validated on write. See [CampaignFlow](/docs/reference/schemas/CampaignFlow/) and [Campaign quickstart](/docs/guides/campaign-quickstart/).

get.description: Returns one campaign within the API key account scope.

patch.description: Updates mutable campaign fields. Mailboxes can be replaced wholesale with `mailbox_ids`, or incrementally edited with `add_mailbox_ids` and `remove_mailbox_ids`. Tags can be replaced with `tag_ids`, or incrementally edited with `add_tag_ids` and `remove_tag_ids`.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the campaign, stops enrollments, and tombstones campaign nodes. Smartlead campaigns remain read-only.

get.description: Lists account-scoped campaign tag definitions.
Lists account-scoped mailbox tag definitions.

patch.description: Changes status for a live campaign (`running`, `paused`, or `stopped`). Draft campaigns must use `POST /launch` instead. Emits campaign status webhooks.

get.description: Returns starter flow graphs for common campaign patterns.

post.description: Deprecated alias for `PATCH /v1/campaigns/{id}/status` with `{ "status": "paused" }`.
Deprecated alias for `PATCH /v1/campaigns/{id}/status` with `{ "status": "stopped" }`.
Deprecated alias for `PATCH /v1/campaigns/{id}/status` with `{ "status": "running" }`.
Launches a draft campaign after verifying that it has a name, flow, and at least one mailbox. Furnace backfills enrollments before switching the campaign to `running`.
Manually pauses enrollments for the given global lead IDs in a native campaign and emits one `enrollment.pause_completed` batch webhook.
Resumes manually paused enrollments for the given global lead IDs. Requires campaign status `running`. Emits one `enrollment.resume_completed` batch webhook.

get.description: Returns the normalized campaign flow graph. If a campaign has no saved flow, Furnace returns an empty `{ nodes: [], edges: [] }` payload. See [CampaignFlow](/docs/reference/schemas/CampaignFlow/) and [Campaign quickstart](/docs/guides/campaign-quickstart/).

put.description: Deprecated alias of `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/flow`. Prefer POST with optional `If-Match`.

post.description: Writes the canonical flow payload. Returns `flow`, `flow_revision`, and `field_sync`. Use `?dry_run=true` to validate without persisting. Optional `If-Match` header for optimistic concurrency. Request body: [FlowUpdate](/docs/reference/schemas/FlowUpdate/).

patch.description: Live content-only patch for supported node types (email, waitTime, dataSender).

post.description: Dry-runs flow normalization, validation, and lifecycle gating without writing changes. See [FlowValidateResult](/docs/reference/schemas/FlowValidateResult/) and [Campaign quickstart](/docs/guides/campaign-quickstart/).

get.description: Returns the mapped standard lead fields and required custom lead field keys extracted from lead source nodes in the campaign flow.

post.description: Appends a custom lead field key to the campaign flow and preserves existing keys.

get.description: Lists non-deleted leads for a campaign. Search matches email and name fields.

post.description: Creates a lead or updates the existing non-deleted lead with the same campaign/email pair. This endpoint supports idempotent retries via `Idempotency-Key` and emits `lead.created` or `lead.updated` outbound webhook events.

get.description: Returns one active lead in the campaign.

patch.description: Updates mutable lead fields and emits `lead.updated`.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the lead, stops its enrollments, cancels queued campaign message jobs, and emits `lead.deleted`.

post.description: Synchronously imports or upserts up to 100 leads in a single request. Per-row lead webhooks are suppressed; Furnace emits one `lead.bulk_import.completed` batch event. Supports idempotent retries with `Idempotency-Key`.

Queues an async import job for up to 1000 leads. Furnace allows at most 3 queued or running async jobs per account at a time. Per-row `lead.created` / `lead.updated` webhooks are suppressed during processing; a single `lead.bulk_import.completed` event is emitted when the job completes successfully.

Creates an async job for any supported bulk operation. Poll `GET /v1/jobs/{id}` for completion. Furnace allows at most 3 queued or running async jobs per account. One operation-specific `*.completed` webhook is emitted when the job finishes successfully.
Adds up to 100 existing account people to a campaign by `global_lead_id`. Emits one `lead.added_to_campaign.completed` batch webhook.
Removes up to 100 leads from a campaign by `global_lead_id`. Emits one `lead.removed_from_campaign.completed` batch webhook.

post.summary: Sync remove leads from all campaigns
post.description: Removes up to 100 people from every campaign in the account. Emits one `lead.removed_from_all_campaigns.completed` batch webhook.

get.description: Returns the account people explorer page with filters, sort, and pagination.
Returns one account person and their campaign memberships.

patch.description: Updates profile fields on all lead rows for the given global lead id.

get.summary: List people in saved lead list

post.summary: Add members to saved lead list

delete.summary: Remove members from saved lead list

get.description: Returns one async lead import job for the authenticated account.
Lists active account mailboxes. Furnace strips `smtp_password` and `imap_password` before returning each mailbox. Results can be filtered by mailbox tags.

patch.description: Updates mailbox tag assignments. Mailbox profile and credential fields remain read-only on the Client API.

get.description: Returns one mailbox without secret password fields.
Lists inbox threads in the authenticated account. By default only threads with at least one inbound reply are returned.
Returns one inbox thread.

patch.description: Updates thread category, conversation status, and/or read state. Category changes emit a `reply.categorized` webhook when configured.

get.description: Lists messages in the thread ordered from oldest to newest.

post.description: Creates an outbound inbox reply job. When `in_reply_to_message_id` is omitted, Furnace targets the latest message in the thread.
Creates an outbound inbox forward job for a specific message in the thread.

put.description: Marks a thread out of office and optionally schedules campaign resume.

delete.description: Clears out-of-office state for a thread.

post.description: Replaces the thread lead with a new contact and optionally queues a forward job.
Assigns an existing account thread tag to the thread.
Removes a thread tag assignment from the thread.

get.description: Lists account thread tags available for assignment.
Returns the status of an outbound inbox reply or forward job.

post.description: Cancels a queued or failed outbound inbox message job.
Requests immediate send for a queued outbound inbox message job.

get.description: Lists block-list entries in the authenticated account.

post.description: Creates a block-list entry for an email address or domain. If an identical entry already exists, Furnace returns the existing row instead of creating a duplicate.

delete.description: Deletes a block-list entry in the authenticated account.

get.description: Returns daily and aggregate campaign stats. When `start_date` and `end_date` are omitted, Furnace defaults the range to campaign creation date through today.
